description: UI wiring for PI/PO settings form, auto-discovery flow, and chat panel. Update btp_cockpit.html with settings form for PI/PO connection parameters and chat interface. Update btp_app.js with form handlers, SSE subscription, and chat logic. Create api-client.js for API methods. Wire Save & Discover button to trigger discovery and update UI.
steps: 1. Create app/aiconx/webapp/api-client.js with API methods: savePipoSystem(config) - POST to /api/tenant/pipo-systems; testPipoConnection(systemId) - POST to /api/tenant/test-connection; triggerDiscovery(systemId) - POST to /api/pipo/systems/{id}/discover; subscribeDiscoveryEvents(jobId, onEvent) - EventSource to /api/discovery/events/{jobId}; sendChatMessage(message, threadId) - POST to /api/brain/chat; getArtifacts(systemId) - GET from /odata/v4/discovery/Artifacts

2. Update app/aiconx/webapp/btp_cockpit.html: In screen-admin section, enhance 'Source System — SAP PI/PO' with full connection form: System Name, Version, Virtual Host, Virtual Port, Protocol (http/https), Location ID, Tech User, Tech Password (masked), Auth Type dropdown, Proxy Type dropdown. Add 'Test Connection' button (existing) and new 'Save & Auto-Discover' button with id='btn-save-discover-pipo'

3. Update app/aiconx/webapp/btp_cockpit.html: Add chat panel div after admin section: <div id='chat-panel' class='chat-panel hidden'> with chat-messages container, chat-input textarea, send button. Style with position:fixed, right side panel, z-index above main content

4. Update app/aiconx/webapp/btp_app.js: Add handler for btn-save-discover-pipo: collect form values, call apiClient.savePipoSystem(), on success call apiClient.triggerDiscovery(), subscribe to SSE events, update UI with progress bar showing discovery phases, on completion show artifact count and enable chat panel

5. Update app/aiconx/webapp/btp_app.js: Add chat panel handlers: toggle chat panel visibility, handle send button click - call apiClient.sendChatMessage(), display response in chat-messages, show tool usage (artifact lookups) in collapsible sections
6. Update app/aiconx/webapp/btp_style.css: Add styles for .chat-panel (fixed position, slide-in animation), .chat-messages, .chat-input, .discovery-progress-bar, .artifact-list

7. Update srv/server.js: Add SSE endpoint /api/discovery/events/:jobId that streams discovery progress. Add /api/brain/chat endpoint that accepts {message, threadId} and returns AI response from BrainService
acceptance_criteria: btp_cockpit.html has PI/PO settings form with all fields and Save & Auto-Discover button
btp_cockpit.html has chat panel div with messages container and input
btp_app.js has handlers for btn-save-discover-pipo and chat send
api-client.js exports savePipoSystem, triggerDiscovery, sendChatMessage functions
verification: Open btp_cockpit.html in browser and verify settings form renders
Verify api-client.js contains expected function exports
findings: CDS build completes for non-CDS artifacts. Pre-existing CDS compilation error in srv/discovery-service.cds (line 36 and 43) regarding @cds.redirection.target annotation - this is unrelated to FEAT-004 UI wiring changes. All JavaScript files pass syntax validation (node --check). UI wiring implemented: api-client.js created with all API methods, btp_cockpit.html enhanced with PI/PO form fields (Virtual Host, Virtual Port, Protocol, Location ID, Version dropdown, Auth Type, Proxy Type), discovery progress bar, artifact summary list, and chat panel. btp_app.js updated with Save & Auto-Discover handler, chat panel handlers, SSE subscription logic. btp_style.css updated with chat panel styles, discovery progress bar, and artifact list styles. srv/server.js updated with SSE endpoint (/api/discovery/events/:jobId), chat endpoint (/api/brain/chat), tenant PI/PO systems endpoint, test connection endpoint, trigger discovery endpoint, and mock discovery process simulation.
